utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] In open session, Mr. Registrar, can you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. Case Number IT-01-47-T, The Prosecutor versus Enver Hadzihasanovic and Amir Kubura.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Appearances for the Prosecution, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. MUNDIS
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. President, Your Honours, counsel, and everyone in and around the courtroom. For the Prosecution, Tecla Benjamin-Henry, Manoj Sachdeva, Matthias Neuner, Kyle Wood, our intern, the case manager, Andres Vatter, and my name is Daryl Mundis.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Mr. Mundis. I'm turning towards the Defence for their appearances.

utterances.speaker: MS. RESIDOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Mr. President, good morning, Your Honours. On behalf of General Hadzihasanovic, Edina Residovic, counsel, Stephane Bourgon, co-counsel, and Muriel Cauvin, legal assistant. Thank you very much.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] The other Defence team, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. IBRISIMOVIC
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good morning, Your Honours. On behalf of Mr. Kubura, Rodney Dixon, Fahrudin Ibrisimovic, and Nermin Mulalic, legal assistant. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. The Chamber would like to greet everybody present here in the courtroom, especially the new persons sitting on the Prosecution Bench. I would like to also greet the Defence teams who are present today. I would like to greet the accused and all the staff of this courtroom who are allowing us and enabling us to hold this session in the best possible way. Mr. Registrar, can we now go into closed session, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, we are back in open session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] In open session, Mr. Mundis, the schedule for next week, would you like to tell us whether there have been any changes to the schedule. We would like to begin on Monday with the witnesses that have been scheduled. So have there been any changes to that?

utterances.speaker: MS. BENJAMIN
utterances.text: Mr. President, in terms of the order, on Monday instead of Mr. Smirko being first, I think Omerkic, the archivist himself will be first. And then Mr. Smirko, because Mr. Smirko is just like a recorder clerk in the archives. And the order continues the same. And I think on Friday, we're going to have the investigator, Peter Hackshaw.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] If I understand you well, on Monday we have Mr. Omerkic first, followed by the employee whose name is Smirko. Maybe we will hear him on Tuesday. On Wednesday, we have the former investigator Mr. Tauro. On Thursday, we have Judge Adamovic. And maybe also on Friday. And on Friday, according to the schedule, we have your investigator Peter Hackshaw. Is that correct?

utterances.speaker: MS. BENJAMIN
utterances.text: Correct, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you. Mr. Bourgon, just a couple minutes.

utterances.speaker: MR. BOURGON
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Very briefly, Your Honour, we have not received Mr. Hackshaw's statement, and my learned friends have promised that they would send it to us as soon as possible. If possible, at the beginning ever the week so as to enable us to prepare for this witness.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mrs. Benjamin, obviously they need to be provided with the statement as soon as possible; that is, Mr. Peter Hackshaw's statement, and he's supposed to testify on Friday.

utterances.speaker: MS. BENJAMIN
utterances.text: Mr. President, at this moment, he's just putting the finishing touches. And presumably this afternoon they may be able to have it, or the first thing on Monday morning.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Mr. Bourgon, the Prosecution has made a promise to send it to you on Monday. If there is nothing else, I would like to thank all of you, and I invite you to be back here on Monday at 14.15 hours. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ANTONETTI
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Monday, the 21st day of June, 2004, at 2.15 p.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 1.59 p.m.,
